description:
I'm Dan Cooper. This channel helps you get your home ready for winter power outages, calmly and without panic.

When a winter storm knocks the power out, the furnace stops, the fridge goes quiet, and the house starts to cool. Here you'll learn simple steps to keep one room warm, keep food and water safe, light your home, and cook without power, using things from Walmart or what you already have.

What you'll find here:
- Staying warm when the heat goes out
- Food and water: what to store, keep or throw out
- Low-cost Walmart items that help in a blackout
- Backup power made simple and safe
- Safety: carbon monoxide, candles, generators, ice

Every tip is checked against the CDC, Ready.gov, FEMA and USDA. Plain words, no fear, no gimmicks.

Subscribe so you're ready before the next storm.
